overview: Sarah McInerney, Dáithí Ó Sé, Emer O'Neill and Thomas Crosse (Crossy) with live coverage from the streets of Dublin.
title: St Patrick's Festival Parade

overview: For over 900 years, Trinity has been an elite playground solely for the uber rich and powerful. However for the first time in its long and illustrious history, Trinity is about to throw open its doors to students from, well, the lower social classes.
title: Trinity

overview: Senior entertainment journalist Liu Chih Chun learns that her colleague Lin Pei Ting, a junior journalist, died at a sex and drug-fuelled party. Consequently, the reputation of the weekly magazine she works for is seriously damaged. As Lin's supervisor, Chih Chun has to uncover the mystery that lies beneath Lin's death and use the scoop to save her career. With the notebook Lin left behind, Chih Chun retraces Lin's steps realizing that Lin posed as a prostitute to secretly investigate the sex scandals in the entertainment business and that the news is just the tip of the iceberg. Balanced between truth and survival, Liu Chih Chun is determined to reveal the truth where danger awaits.
title: Tabloid

overview: Max, Mell, Ema, Robin and Sonia. As part of a responsible approach to their studies, five addictionology students decide on an experiment - to take drugs that could temporarily solve the problems of each of them. As Professor Jensen says, drugs are shortcuts to solving problems. But the experiment has one significant catch. The effect of the drugs will become permanent for everyone. Fun and newly acquired "superpowers" lead the young heroes to the edge of their possibilities, but also of their strength. And all this in a situation where the function of a drug coordinator has been established in the country, which approaches the drug problem with maximum severity...
title: Adikts

overview: Donal Skehan is joined by chefs and special guests as they explore the vibrant flavours of various celebrations.
title: Donal's Festival Kitchen

overview: This gripping three-part documentary dives deep into the science of addiction and recovery - whether it's phones, alcohol, gambling, or hard drugs.
title: Hooked: How Addiction Hijacks Your Brain

overview: After 25 years of marriage, Eloísa discovers her husband's infidelity with a younger man and decides to separate. Her unexpected loneliness forces her to question herself and find the courage to rediscover love.
title: Con Esa Misma Mirada

overview: A new school year starts at Constantino Quijano High School, where a new generation on of students is ready to create unforgettable moments. Sofi, the confident cheerleading captain, has sworn off dating after her breakup with Alan, the football team's star player. But her resolve is tested with the arrival of Quique—a charming new student with a bold dream. Quique is determined to conquer his stage fright and pursue acting, hoping to impress the father he's never met, a renowned singer. Through thrilling adventures, friendships, and unexpected twists, the students of La CQ discover that at this high school, the possibilities are as limitless as their imaginations.
title: La CQ: nuevo ingreso

overview: A Keio University (one of the top three colleges in Japan) exam candidate, Touma Inaba, is interupted when a cute young girl, Urara Kasuga, arrives at his hotel room door. She later turns out to be his cousin who he barely remembers from his childhood. Urara, who had felt something special for him (an other-than-cousinly-love), invites Touma to live with her since he has no place to stay other than the hotel room. Before taking the test, Touma meets Meiko Yotsuba, a beautiful, sophisticated woman also trying to get into Keio. Meiko gets into Keio but Touma does not, due to a cold Urara had given him shortly before. Although he did not make it, he pretends he does to earn the respect of Meiko. Touma is caught up in a love triangle with Urara and Meiko, while struggling to keep Meiko believing he's really a Keio student and still be there for Urara at the same time. This is OVA adaptation of the manga, initially released on 6 VHS cassettes.
title: Sakura Tsuushin

overview: Hosted by one of Australia's favourite stand-up comedians Claire Hooper, the play along at home quiz show will see four celebrity players battle it out each week to test their skills in an entertaining series of trivia-based puzzles, riddles and brain teasers. Each Monday to Friday night, four competing celebrities will back it up as Claire dishes out a different mix of head-scratching games all designed to fuel the celebrity players' competitiveness and test their mental prowess. Stepping up to the podium is an eclectic mix of famous faces, including Olympic swimmer Emily Seebohm, television personality Jamie Durie, celebrity cook Julie Goodwin, ABC presenter favourites Costa Georgiadis and Zan Rowe, actor and performer Eddie Perfect and comedians Lizzy Hoo, Rhys Nicholson, Nazeem Hussain and Geraldine Hickey. Following a quick-fire round, a nightly winner is declared each episode, awarding them bragging rights and their pick of the kitsch-inspired ‘House of Games' merchandise. Who wouldn't want to walk away with their very own ‘must-have' salad spinner or fun fondue set? At the end of the week points are then tallied and an overall weekly winner will be crowned champion and awarded the highly coveted ‘House of Games' trophy. Fun, witty and full of surprises, Claire Hooper's House of Games is a limited series game show where the quiz is king, but the game will make you grin.
title: Claire Hooper's House of Games

overview: Travel documentaries about the new subculture of "trailwalkers", personal freedom, landscape, history, people, meeting, Mirek Vladyka will present the northern route of the unique Czech Trail.
title: Stezka Českem

overview: Kauza Kramný focuses on the case of Petr Kramný, convicted of murdering his wife and daughter during a vacation in Egypt in 2013. After more than ten years we show the fates of people whose lives were changed by this case.
title: Kauza Kramný

overview: A quirky guide to Prague's pubs, bars and taverns based on the bestseller by Radim Kopác and Petr Stancík.
title: Praha ožralá

overview: Stories of the creation of the most important Czech games that have shaped generations of fans. A documentary series about computer games and game developers from the late 1980s to the present.
title: Game Story

overview: 8 murders, 2 attempted murders, 2 robberies
title: Případ Stodolovi

overview: There are many unique technical monuments in our country, the significance of which transcends borders and time. Industrial heritage is conducted by Miroslav Táborský. We will see expeditions to attractions from mining, military and other interesting fields.
title: Technické klenoty

overview: Eight cases for the Authority for the paranormal phenomena
title: To se vysvětlí, soudruzi!

overview: Zofie and Andrea offer paid content on adult platforms. While Zofie tries to rebuild her damaged self-esteem after breaking up with Roman and experiment with these platforms, Andrea longs for financial freedom which moves her from her original goal of making a living by serious modeling. Zofie sees adult platforms as a kind of emancipation tool, while financial situation and demands of fans drive once famous Andrea deeper into darker waters of sex influencership.
title: Vlastně se nic nestalo

overview: The owners of a successful IT start-up, Hynek, Gabriel and Stepan, threaten the interests of a dangerous mobster and have to flee Prague. On the run, they find asylum in a hotel where they pose as bartenders under false identities.
title: Lež na pláži

overview: Even in holiday paradise, sometimes things go wrong. And sometimes they kill.
title: Policie Hvar

overview: The story of a family, which is shaken by the sudden separation of the parents. They decide to find themselves, but each separately. Before that, they have to find a new homes, so they temporarily travel to the families of their children.
title: Mozaika

overview: The story of the Záhorský family and their family crematorium. One would think that it would be quite dead in such an enterprise, but strange, mysterious (and it must be said, very funny) events begin to happen to the Záhorskys, which cross the line of life, death, and above all black humor.
title: Krematorium

overview: Boss is an American political drama television series staring Kelsey Grammer as Tom Kane, the mayor of Chicago, who has recently been diagnosed with dementia with Lewy bodies, a degenerative neurological disorder.
title: Boss

overview: An Island Parish is a British television documentary made by Tiger Aspect Productions for BBC2 which covers the lives of residents in the Island parish of the Isles of Scilly, the remotest parish within the Church of England.
title: An Island Parish

overview: Gothic architecture was born in France and over the course of three centuries swept almost all of Europe, including Bohemia.
title: Středověké srdce Evropy

overview: What were ancient battles really like? The answer is known to people who have been enchanted by the clank of old weapons, the smell of gunpowder and the weight of medieval armor. We take a look at old battles through the eyes of people who have made it a lifelong hobby.
title: K poctě zbraň!

overview: Priest and presenter Zbigniew Czendlik, known as Zibi, gets behind the wheel of a caravan and sets off on a journey across a vast country, in whose voivodeships you can find unique monuments, natural attractions, centuries-old traditions and excellent gastronomy. He is interested in the history hidden in the cities, as well as the natural beauty that gives an idea of the diversity of the Polish landscape, which stretches from our borders to the Baltic Sea. These riches, together with the friendliness of the local people, are the reason why Zibi embarks on a journey through his native land with enthusiasm and anticipation.
title: V karavanu po Polsku

overview: Presented by seductive Japanese mistress Mia, this game sees a group of men (hidden behind mirrored glass) ranking a group of women on the basis of various physical attributes. Unable to hear the men, the women must rank themselves in the order that they think the men will put them. For every position they are correct about they win £500 cash.
title: Hot Tub Ranking

overview: A series of documentaries about those without whom the USSR's victory in the Great Patriotic War would have been impossible. Each episode reveals details of the biographies of famous Soviet aircraft designers and scientists. The viewer will learn about the career ups and downs of Pavel Sukhoi, Andrei Tupolev, Nikolai Kamov and many others.
title: Повелители неба. Крылья победы

overview: Two young provincial girls, Ira and Zhenya, come to conquer Moscow. If Irina, the eldest of them, has a specific goal of becoming an actress, then Zhenya's plans are not so ambitious. Her passion is cars, motorcycles, engines, and she would be satisfied with any job related to cars. However, the life of the friends in Moscow is not like a fairy tale - Evgenia cannot find work in any car service, they only need men, and Ira fails to "cleanly" enter the institute, and she is accepted only as an auditor. Chance gives them the opportunity to meet an elderly writer, who also works as a janitor in her own yard. The writer needs extraordinary, life observations, and the two unusual girls find shelter with her for a promise to tell everything about their lives. And life changes dramatically.
title: Главные роли

overview: The Russian filmmakers dedicated their thriller to the memory of the outstanding director Alfred Hitchcock. In each episode, the "Master of Horror" will reveal one of his professional secrets. The series uses the plots of the classic's stories. With his inherent desire to understand all the shades of fear, all the degrees of horror, all the flavors of a nightmare. Each film is a complete story with a stunning detective intrigue.
title: Блюстители порока

overview: Anna is a controversial influencer and best known for her provocative online content, but suddenly she goes silent on her social media profiles and mysteriously stops posting any updates. When fifteen-year-old Nina finds a half-naked photo of Anna on her dad's phone, she decides to track down the missing influencer. The shocking events that follow will change not only Nina's life but also her family's. The thriller #annaismissing is a standalone film continuation of the successful series #martyisdead, which was honored with an International Emmy Award in 2020
title: #annaismissing

overview: Xiao Lang, the newly appointed director, makes a bold entrance—but he's hiding a secret past. Once the rightful heir, he lost everything to his stepmother's scheming. The only light in his dark childhood was Su Mingyu. Now back for revenge, her love becomes his salvation again as love triumphs over vengeance.
title: Heart of Stone

overview: This gripping documentary series depicts the emotional everyday life at one of the country's largest emergency hospitals, where we also get to follow all the people who work tirelessly day in and day out to save lives.
title: S:t Görans sjukhus

overview: Even gangsters can be fun. Each part carries a complete story. The individual stories are told with a disarmingly inaccurate exaggeration, taking the best of what has been created in the genre of crime and gangster films and working with interesting pop culture references.
title: Bodyguardi

overview: Jerónimo Lynch, owner of the "Lynch Funeral Home", is about to be arrested and accepts Isabel Reyes' offer to stage his death. This leads to the setting up of an enterprise staging the death of people who wish to take on a new identity.
title: Lynch

overview: It is said that "All-Service House" accepts any task, whether it's walking dogs, finding cats, or… even stabbing people. Da Hei reluctantly takes on these odd jobs to earn medical funds, unaware that his roommate Xiao Bai is secretly an operative sent by the intelligence agency to take them down. After completing mission after mission, the two rookies' growing dependence on each other deepens each day. But can they be together? Will they choose to reform their ways or continue down the dark path?
title: Fight for You
Hello, Nice to Meet You. Could You Please Divorce Me?

overview: Dr. Elizabeth Goode is a therapist who works with celebrities in Los Angeles. Celebrities in LA tend to live fast and hard in a rock-n-roll roller coaster lifestyle that has some rough ups and downs. And as a result, these celebrities need help to deal with some of their personal issues--help from a sympathetic and understanding and professional person. Dr. Elizabeth Goode is not that person.
title: Head Case

overview: Matvey, a good-natured IT guy, is hopelessly in love with the dazzling beauty Sveta. A relationship could have developed, but Matthew's extra pounds get up between young people. Sveta sees an overweight guy as just a friend. Matvey understands that his love will remain hopeless if he does not lose a few tens of kilograms. At the gym, Matvey meets a tough coach, Yulia. A difficult life situation forces Yulia to accept Matvey's offer, and become for him not only a coach, but also willpower, a supervisor, and then his best friend.
title: Большой человек

overview: Corpse herder Xiao Jiu receives a strange late-night order from a mysterious woman to deliver the body of a wealthy young man to an old mansion. Upon arrival, she discovers his parents are preparing a ghost marriage for him. But the next day, they show up at her door claiming the body has vanished, and they demand she return their son's corpse...
title: The Mystery of Dragon Town

overview: A comedy TV series set in the wild countryside. To save his marriage, Lukyn decides to take part in an amateur band competition, in which he wins a beautiful motorbike. When he succeeds, he takes his wife out on the motorbike and she will surely forgive him for everything. In short, a perfect plan! What does it matter that Lukyn doesn't have a band and that he can't really play anything...
title: Agrometal

overview: On the show, a cast of seven kids known as Zoomers presented various activities such as games, plays, poems, recipes, jokes, movies and science experiments, all suggested by viewer contributions. The cast also had informal chats on subjects such as hospitals, school, family and prejudice, titled Zoomraps. Each episode ended with a choreographed song performed by the cast.
title: Zoom

overview: In an unprecedented spectacle we present to you the hottest 50 reality stars in Germany, including Jenny Elvers, Cosimo, Yasin, Cora Schumacher, Georgina Fleur and Matthias Mangiapane - all in one show! In a mysterious castle, ruled by a mischievous lion they fight not for themselves, but for their fans, one of whom will be awarded the prize
title: The 50

overview: What exceptional manuscripts are stored in our National Library?
title: Poklady Klementina

overview: A beautiful young space traveler awakens aboard an adrift shuttle with no memory of who she is or how she got there and at the mercy of the ship's mysterious computer.
title: Continuum

overview: Dan Dailey stars as private detective Frank Faraday in this 90-minute series, which will share this time period along with "Banacek," "Tenafly'' and "The Snoop Sisters." Dan Dailey returns in a series as a private eye, Frank Faraday. Format calls for Faraday, having served 28 years in a South American jail for a crime he didn't commit, to return to the United States. Not only does he come home to a new era, but a son he didn't know he had (James Naughton). They team up as detectives, with Faraday determined to get the man who killed his old partner.
title: Faraday and Company

overview: For millennia, volcanoes have inspired both awe and fear. In this two-part series comedian and presenter Dara Ó Briain explores the immense power of Italy's most active volcanoes. There's Stromboli, whose constant eruptions have earned its nickname 'Lighthouse of the Mediterranean'. Mount Etna, where volcanic soils produce some of the best wines in the world. And Vesuvius, where a devastating eruption thousands of years ago buried a city and boiled the brains of its inhabitants. With stunning visuals, gripping stories, and Dara's trademark wit, this series uncovers the deadly force of volcanoes and their lasting impact on our planet.
title: Volcano with Dara O Briain

overview: A sparkling celebrity laughter show where the stars, armed with secret phrases, pit their wits against each other.
title: The Railway Carriage Game

overview: The architecture of the years 1958 to 1989 still arouses passion today. The series, based on the theme of Vladimir 518, takes a comprehensive look at this period, without ideological prejudices.
title: Architektura 58-89

overview: When Leanne and Matty discover they are both robbing from the safe at the inner-city casino they work in, their lives are set on a collision course; with each other, the local gangster they're stealing from, and the police
title: The Cage

overview: Pulls back the glamorous curtain of fame to expose the hidden struggles, sacrifices and scandals of life in the spotlight. From the seemingly cursed dynasties like the Von Erich wrestling family to iconic figures like 7th Heaven's pastor dad Stephen Collins, who are far from their beloved characters, and series plagued by peril and misfortune like Mighty Morphin Power Rangers and The Real Housewives, this new series unveils the shadowy underbelly of Hollywood.
title: Hollywood Demons

overview: The Take is a four episode British drama TV series on Sky 1 based upon the Martina Cole novel. Shooting for the show took place in Dublin. The show premiered on 17 June 2009 and stars Tom Hardy, Brian Cox, Hayley Angel Holt, Shaun Evans, Kierston Wareing, and Charlotte Riley. The show received critical acclaim, mainly for Tom Hardy's portrayal of criminal sociopath Freddie Jackson.
title: The Take
